title: When the self keeps asking to be the center
issueStatement: The room may look calm, but inwardly everything is being measured by injury, credit, image, or control.
centralInsight: Gurbani names haumai as distortion, not personality. The cure is not self-hatred but truthful smallness before the One.
practicalReflection: Ego does not only boast. It narrates, protects, compares, resents, and makes every moment answer to the self.
actionPrompt: Notice where the self is asking to be confirmed, defended, or admired, and refuse to feed that demand immediately.

daily.label: Daily
daily.title: Ego in ordinary interactions
daily.issueStatement: Most ego is not loud. It appears in the tiny insistences, interpretations, and quiet resentments that fill an ordinary day.
daily.centralInsight: The Guru brings ego into view by exposing how even casual interactions become self-referential when remembrance is thin.
daily.practicalReflection: If the day is full of inner commentary about being seen rightly, thanked properly, or treated specially, the self has taken too much space.
daily.actionPrompt: In one ordinary interaction today, choose listening over self-assertion and let the moment remain unedited by pride.

pressure.label: Under Pressure
pressure.title: Ego when you feel cornered
pressure.issueStatement: Pressure makes ego feel righteous. The self becomes convinced that sharpness, self-protection, and control are simply what the moment requires.
pressure.centralInsight: Under strain, humility is not weakness. It is what prevents pressure from turning panic into identity.
pressure.practicalReflection: The pressured ego wants to secure itself first and reflect later. Gurbani reverses that order.
pressure.actionPrompt: When you feel cornered, delay the defensive sentence long enough to ask what humility would sound like here.

repair.label: After the Slip
repair.title: Returning after pride has spoken
repair.issueStatement: The ego has already taken over the mouth, the posture, or the story, and now it wants to call self-justification honesty.
repair.centralInsight: Repair begins when pride is interrupted before it becomes identity. Gurbani teaches confession without self-dramatization.
repair.practicalReflection: You do not return from ego by crafting a better image of humility. You return by releasing the need to manage the image at all.
repair.actionPrompt: Name the pride plainly, apologize without self-defense where needed, and let one consequence stand without argument.

practice.label: Steady Practice
practice.title: Practicing a smaller self
practice.issueStatement: Even after insight arrives, the ego keeps rebuilding itself through habit, especially in the places where competence or hurt feel most personal.
practice.centralInsight: Humility becomes stable through practice: repeated acts that return credit, soften speech, and keep the self from narrating everything back to itself.
practice.practicalReflection: The self shrinks healthily when service, praise, and truth are given more room than self-display.
practice.actionPrompt: Choose one place where you usually reach for recognition and practice hidden goodness there until the hunger weakens.
